exposure: Targeted dietary modification and nutrition for pregnant women
Conventional filing of targeted dietary modification and nutrition
cohort: 200 pregnant women who received targeted dietary guidance (experimental group) and 200 pregnant women who received conventional care (control group) at Mary Maternity Hospital.
finding: Targeted dietary modification and nutrition for pregnant women significantly reduced the incidence rate of complications and the cesarean section rate, demonstrating positive significance on maternal and child health.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate of the experimental group was lower than that of the control group.
